description: CivicFix Production Cloudflare WAF & Bot Mitigation Ruleset

rules.description: Block aggressive bursts targeting asynchronous report creation
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/v1/reports" or http.request.uri.path eq "/reports") and http.request.method eq "POST"

rules.description: Block automated scrapers and malicious crawler traffic
Protect staff administrative dashboards from unauthorized foreign CIDR ranges
rules.expression: http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/v1/work-orders" and not ip.geoip.country in {"US", "CA"}
